visual_brief: Guangzhou CTF Finance Centre has a pale, vertically ribbed facade, a rectangular shaft, asymmetric setbacks and a split-height crown. It stands beside K11 and Guangzhou Library on the east side of Huacheng Square; views across the square or Pearl River reveal its recognizable profile. Distinguish it from the rounded dark Guangzhou IFC West Tower, lattice-waisted Canton Tower, and smoothly tapered Tianjin CTF tower.
notes: Six distinct JPEG photographs verified; c1 is recommended. c2/c3 are 2000-pixel landscape alternatives; c4/c5 have overcast light. Source pages state no reuse licence. References were used only for identity. Downloads used Node after Python was unavailable and curl failed TLS; all files passed JPEG decoding and dimension checks.
